build_task_with_define_task: build a phyre task using the define_task decorator to create a spatial reasoning scenario
create_boxes_with_add_box: create boxes in a phyre scene using add_box with width and height parameters
position_bodies_with_set_bottom: position a body in the scene by setting its bottom coordinate relative to another body
position_bodies_with_set_left: position a body in the scene by setting its left coordinate to a specific value
define_goal_with_update_task: define a task goal using update_task with two bodies and a NOT_TOUCHING spatial relationship
